scripts.build:local: npm run build && mkdir -p ../src/souwen/server && cp dist/index.html ../src/souwen/server/panel.html
scripts.check:artifact: test -f dist/index.html && test -f ../src/souwen/server/panel.html && cmp -s dist/index.html ../src/souwen/server/panel.html || (echo 'embedded Panel artifact is missing or differs from panel/dist/index.html. Run npm run build:local.' >&2 && exit 1)
